name: Meteostat
tagline: Historical weather and climate data by station or coordinates via RapidAPI
description: Meteostat’s JSON API serves historical hourly, daily, and monthly weather observations plus climate normals from thousands of stations and model-backed point queries. Hosted on RapidAPI, it returns JSON with meta and data objects for station lookup, nearby search, and time-series ranges. Free for light use (500 calls/month); paid tiers raise monthly quotas. Separate free bulk dumps and a Python library exist outside this API.

auth.details: RapidAPI key via X-RapidAPI-Key header (and x-rapidapi-host: meteostat.p.rapidapi.com). Alternative: rapidapi-key query param. Sign up on RapidAPI and subscribe to a Meteostat plan.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 500 requests per month (hard limit on Basic/free plan)
pricing.paid_plans: Pro $9.99/mo (10,000 req/mo); Ultra $29.99/mo (35,000); Mega $99.99/mo (120,000) via RapidAPI

rate_limits: Free: 500 req/month hard limit. Paid plans raise monthly quota only. HTTP 429 when quota exceeded. Per-request caps: hourly max 30 days; daily max 10 years. No separate per-second limit published.
use_cases: get historical daily temperatures for a weather station
fetch hourly observations for a station over a date range
look up weather station metadata by Meteostat, WMO, or ICAO id
find nearby weather stations for a lat/lon
get monthly climate stats for a geographic point
retrieve long-term climate normals for a station
